// A small in-memory rate limiter with a sliding window.
// Written as a fixture for the token estimator tests.

export interface RateLimitOptions {
  /** Maximum number of calls allowed inside one window. */
  limit: number;
  /** Window length in milliseconds. */
  windowMs: number;
  /** Injected clock, so tests do not need to sleep. */
  now?: () => number;
}

export interface RateLimitResult {
  allowed: boolean;
  remaining: number;
  retryAfterMs: number;
}

type Bucket = { hits: number[]; lastSeen: number };

export class SlidingWindowLimiter {
  private readonly buckets = new Map<string, Bucket>();
  private readonly limit: number;
  private readonly windowMs: number;
  private readonly now: () => number;

  constructor(options: RateLimitOptions) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(options.limit) || options.limit <= 0) {
      throw new RangeError(`limit must be a positive integer, got ${options.limit}`);
    }
    this.limit = options.limit;
    this.windowMs = options.windowMs;
    this.now = options.now ?? Date.now;
  }

  /** Records one call for `key` and reports whether it is allowed. */
  check(key: string): RateLimitResult {
    const t = this.now();
    const bucket = this.buckets.get(key) ?? { hits: [], lastSeen: t };
    const cutoff = t - this.windowMs;

    // Drop timestamps that have fallen out of the window.
    let firstValid = 0;
    while (firstValid < bucket.hits.length && bucket.hits[firstValid] <= cutoff) {
      firstValid++;
    }
    if (firstValid > 0) bucket.hits.splice(0, firstValid);

    bucket.lastSeen = t;
    this.buckets.set(key, bucket);

    if (bucket.hits.length >= this.limit) {
      const oldest = bucket.hits[0];
      return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterMs: oldest + this.windowMs - t };
    }

    bucket.hits.push(t);
    return {
      allowed: true,
      remaining: this.limit - bucket.hits.length,
      retryAfterMs: 0,
    };
  }

  /** Removes buckets that have been idle for longer than `maxIdleMs`. */
  sweep(maxIdleMs: number = this.windowMs * 2): number {
    const t = this.now();
    let removed = 0;
    for (const [key, bucket] of this.buckets) {
      if (t - bucket.lastSeen > maxIdleMs) {
        this.buckets.delete(key);
        removed += 1;
      }
    }
    return removed;
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.buckets.size;
  }
}

export function formatRetryAfter(ms: number): string {
  if (ms <= 0) return 'now';
  const seconds = Math.ceil(ms / 1000);
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const rest = seconds % 60;
  return rest === 0 ? `${minutes}m` : `${minutes}m ${rest}s`;
}

async function demo(): Promise<void> {
  const limiter = new SlidingWindowLimiter({ limit: 3, windowMs: 1_000 });
  const results = ['a', 'a', 'a', 'a', 'b'].map((k) => [k, limiter.check(k)] as const);
  for (const [key, r] of results) {
    console.log(`${key}: allowed=${r.allowed} remaining=${r.remaining} retry=${formatRetryAfter(r.retryAfterMs)}`);
  }
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1_100));
  console.log('after window:', limiter.check('a'), 'buckets:', limiter.size);
}

demo().catch((err: unknown) => {
  console.error('demo failed', err);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
